title: ModelNameParseResult
description: Delta payload for the arbitrary upstream model-name parser (A2). Total function: any input yields a result or a typed error, never a panic.

clean_name.description: Human-readable name with no provider prefix, hash suffix, or quantization token, e.g. qwen2-5-coder-3b-instruct

quantization.description: Recovered quantization token, e.g. q4_k_m (preserved, not discarded)

derived_id.description: Collision-safe identifier from the existing naming.Registry
